```{python .marimo}
from manim import UP, DEGREES, OUT, IN, Cylinder, VGroup, always_rotate, ORIGIN, Arrow3D, TracedPath
from manim_widget import ManimWidget
```

```{python .marimo}
class Dumbbell(ManimWidget):
    def construct(self):
        self.set_camera_orientation(phi=90*DEGREES)
        dumbbellEnd1 = Cylinder(1, .5).shift(OUT*1.5)
        dumbbellEnd2 = Cylinder(1, .5).shift(IN*1.5)
        dumbbellShaft = Cylinder(.08, 2.5)#.shift(OUT)
        dumbbell = VGroup(dumbbellEnd1, dumbbellEnd2, dumbbellShaft).rotate(30*DEGREES, UP)
        self.add(dumbbell)
        always_rotate(dumbbell, 3.1415, about_point=ORIGIN, axis=OUT)
```

```{python .marimo}
Dumbbell(is_3d=True)
```
